Who we are:
Dajo is an integrated energy company with business operations across the O&G ecosystem, mainly in the upstream and midstream sectors. Dajo’s core activities include EPC services, Vessel Operations and Gas commercialisation. We are currently pursuing a growth strategy aimed at doubling our activities via strategic partnerships, acquiring new marine assets and identifying and securing new EPC projects.
Role Summary:
The Senior Financial Accountant will play a pivotal role in supporting the Finance Lead in delivering robust financial reporting, project-based financial management, and forward-looking financial planning across the Company’s oil & gas and marine operations. The role requires strong technical capability in IFRS-compliant reporting, project finance accounting, and financial planning & analysis (FP&A), with direct responsibility for tracking project economics, monitoring contract performance, and supporting capital-intensive investments (e.g., vessels, offshore infrastructure, and energy assets).
Job Responsibilities:
Financial Reporting & Close:
•        Lead and support the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes, ensuring accurate recognition of revenue (contract-based / milestone / IFRS 15), project costs and accruals, and capital expenditure (CapEx) and asset capitalization.
•        Prepare management accounts and statutory financial statements aligned with IFRS and industry-specific accounting treatments.
•        Maintain detailed project-level financial reporting for marine and energy contracts.
•        Prepare and maintain GLs, Trial Balance, and annual financial reports.
Project Finance & Cost Control:
•        Track and monitor project financial performance, including budget vs actual cost analysis, contract profitability and margin tracking, and cost-to-complete and forecast revisions.
•        Support financial oversight of marine assets (vessels), offshore operations, and infrastructure investments.
•        Work closely with operations to ensure accurate cost allocation and cost recovery mechanisms.
•        Conduct financial performance analysis including cost per operating day and profitability metrics.
•        Support commercial evaluations of contract pricing and operational decisions.
Budgeting & Forecasting (FP&A):
•        Develop and maintain financial models for projects and investments, including cash flow projections, NPV, IRR, and payback analysis, and scenario and sensitivity analysis (FX, oil prices, cost escalation).
•        Prepare annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating project pipelines, contract timelines, and funding requirements.
•        Monitor budget utilization and highlight deviations or cost overruns.
•        Provide forward-looking insights to support strategic decision-making and capital allocation.
•        Support long-term financial planning for asset acquisitions, upgrades, and capital projects.
Treasury, Liquidity & Funding Support:
•        Monitor project and corporate cash flows, ensuring alignment with CapEx schedules, debt servicing obligations, and operational funding needs.
•        Support working capital optimization, particularly receivables from contracts and payables to vendors and contractors.
•        Assist in managing banking relationships, funding structures, and drawdown schedules for project financing.
•        Prepare receivables and payables reports and conduct reconciliations.
Asset & CAPEX Accounting:
•        Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules for marine and energy assets.
•        Account for major repairs, dry-docking, and capitalized asset costs.
•        Support evaluation of asset impairment and valuation when required.
•        Ensure integrity of the general ledger including balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and adjustments.
Invoicing & Payment Management:
•        Timely preparation of invoices for services, charter hires, and projects.
•        Review and verify vendor invoices, delivery notes, and service completion certificates.
•        Process payments, ensuring compliance with internal approval matrix and banking procedures.
•        Coordinate with procurement and technical teams to ensure proper documentation for payments.
Audit, Compliance & Regulatory Reporting:
•        Coordinate external and internal audits, ensuring readiness of project schedules, supporting documentation, and financial disclosures.
•        Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., NUPRC, NCDMB, NIMASA) and financial reporting standards.
•        Support compliance with tax obligations (VAT, WHT, CIT) and industry-specific levies (e.g., NCDF, Cabotage).
•        Strengthen and enforce internal control frameworks, particularly around project expenditure, procurement, and vendor payments.
Performance Monitoring & Business Partnering:
•        Provide financial performance dashboards for management, including project profitability, cost efficiency metrics, and liquidity indicators.
•        Act as a finance business partner to operations, commercial, and project teams.
•        Support evaluation of new business opportunities, bids, and tenders with financial input.
•        Provide direct support to the Finance Lead in strategic planning, capital allocation decisions, and investor/lender reporting.
Process Improvement & Systems:
•        Identify inefficiencies in financial reporting, project tracking, and data management systems.
•        Support implementation of automation tools and financial systems to enhance reporting accuracy and speed.
•        Improve data integrity and reporting standardisation across projects.
Experience & Qualifications:
•        Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
•        Relevant professional qualification (e.g. ICAN, ACCA, CIMA) is required or strongly preferred.
•        Minimum of 5 years’ cognate finance experience, preferably within oil & gas, energy, marine, or  infrastructure operations.
•        Solid working knowledge of IFRS and management accounting principles.
•        Hands-on experience with accounting software and financial systems.
•        Experience in project finance accounting is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies:
•        Strong knowledge of IFRS and project-based accounting principles.
•        Advanced financial modelling and Excel skills (NPV, IRR, scenario analysis).
•        Strong analytical and financial reporting capability, with a focus on accuracy and timeliness.
•        Understanding of FX exposure, funding structures, and capital-intensive operations.
•        Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, and accounting software.
•        Ability to manage reconciliations across vendor and project accounts with minimal error.
•        Capacity to work independently, prioritise effectively, and meet tight reporting deadlines.
•        Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across technical, operations, and commercial teams.
•        High attention to detail with a strong compliance and audit orientation.
Benefits:

**Job Vacancy:**


**Senior Financial Accountant**


* Company: Dajo Energy Limited.


* Location: Victoria Island


* State: Lagos, Nigeria


* Job type: Full\-Time \- Onsite


* Report to: Finance Lead

  


**Who we are:**


Dajo is an integrated energy company with business operations across the O\&G ecosystem, mainly in the upstream and midstream sectors. Dajo’s core activities include EPC services, Vessel Operations and Gas commercialisation. We are currently pursuing a growth strategy aimed at doubling our activities via strategic partnerships, acquiring new marine assets and identifying and securing new EPC projects.

  


**Role Summary:**


The Senior Financial Accountant will play a pivotal role in supporting the Finance Lead in delivering robust financial reporting, project\-based financial management, and forward\-looking financial planning across the Company’s oil \& gas and marine operations. The role requires strong technical capability in IFRS\-compliant reporting, project finance accounting, and financial planning \& analysis (FP\&A), with direct responsibility for tracking project economics, monitoring contract performance, and supporting capital\-intensive investments (e.g., vessels, offshore infrastructure, and energy assets).

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


**Financial Reporting \& Close:**


* Lead and support the monthly, quarterly, and year\-end close processes, ensuring accurate recognition of revenue (contract\-based / milestone / IFRS 15\), project costs and accruals, and capital expenditure (CapEx) and asset capitalization.


* Prepare management accounts and statutory financial statements aligned with IFRS and industry\-specific accounting treatments.


* Maintain detailed project\-level financial reporting for marine and energy contracts.


* Prepare and maintain GLs, Trial Balance, and annual financial reports.


**Project Finance \& Cost Control:**


* Track and monitor project financial performance, including budget vs actual cost analysis, contract profitability and margin tracking, and cost\-to\-complete and forecast revisions.


* Support financial oversight of marine assets (vessels), offshore operations, and infrastructure investments.


* Work closely with operations to ensure accurate cost allocation and cost recovery mechanisms.


* Conduct financial performance analysis including cost per operating day and profitability metrics.


* Support commercial evaluations of contract pricing and operational decisions.


**Budgeting \& Forecasting (FP\&A):**


* Develop and maintain financial models for projects and investments, including cash flow projections, NPV, IRR, and payback analysis, and scenario and sensitivity analysis (FX, oil prices, cost escalation).


* Prepare annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating project pipelines, contract timelines, and funding requirements.


* Monitor budget utilization and highlight deviations or cost overruns.


* Provide forward\-looking insights to support strategic decision\-making and capital allocation.


* Support long\-term financial planning for asset acquisitions, upgrades, and capital projects.


**Treasury, Liquidity \& Funding Support:**


* Monitor project and corporate cash flows, ensuring alignment with CapEx schedules, debt servicing obligations, and operational funding needs.


* Support working capital optimization, particularly receivables from contracts and payables to vendors and contractors.


* Assist in managing banking relationships, funding structures, and drawdown schedules for project financing.


* Prepare receivables and payables reports and conduct reconciliations.


**Asset \& CAPEX Accounting:**


* Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules for marine and energy assets.


* Account for major repairs, dry\-docking, and capitalized asset costs.


* Support evaluation of asset impairment and valuation when required.


* Ensure integrity of the general ledger including balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and adjustments.


**Invoicing \& Payment Management:**


* Timely preparation of invoices for services, charter hires, and projects.


* Review and verify vendor invoices, delivery notes, and service completion certificates.


* Process payments, ensuring compliance with internal approval matrix and banking procedures.


* Coordinate with procurement and technical teams to ensure proper documentation for payments.


**Audit, Compliance \& Regulatory Reporting:**


* Coordinate external and internal audits, ensuring readiness of project schedules, supporting documentation, and financial disclosures.


* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., NUPRC, NCDMB, NIMASA) and financial reporting standards.


* Support compliance with tax obligations (VAT, WHT, CIT) and industry\-specific levies (e.g., NCDF, Cabotage).


* Strengthen and enforce internal control frameworks, particularly around project expenditure, procurement, and vendor payments.


**Performance Monitoring \& Business Partnering:**


* Provide financial performance dashboards for management, including project profitability, cost efficiency metrics, and liquidity indicators.


* Act as a finance business partner to operations, commercial, and project teams.


* Support evaluation of new business opportunities, bids, and tenders with financial input.


* Provide direct support to the Finance Lead in strategic planning, capital allocation decisions, and investor/lender reporting.


**Process Improvement \& Systems:**


* Identify inefficiencies in financial reporting, project tracking, and data management systems.


* Support implementation of automation tools and financial systems to enhance reporting accuracy and speed.


* Improve data integrity and reporting standardisation across projects.

  


**Experience \& Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.


* Relevant professional qualification (e.g. ICAN, ACCA, CIMA) is required or strongly preferred.


* Minimum of 5 years’ cognate finance experience, preferably within oil \& gas, energy, marine, or infrastructure operations.


* Solid working knowledge of IFRS and management accounting principles.


* Hands\-on experience with accounting software and financial systems.


* Experience in project finance accounting is a strong advantage.


**Skills \& Competencies:**


* Strong knowledge of IFRS and project\-based accounting principles.


* Advanced financial modelling and Excel skills (NPV, IRR, scenario analysis).


* Strong analytical and financial reporting capability, with a focus on accuracy and timeliness.


* Understanding of FX exposure, funding structures, and capital\-intensive operations.


* Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, and accounting software.


* Ability to manage reconciliations across vendor and project accounts with minimal error.


* Capacity to work independently, prioritise effectively, and meet tight reporting deadlines.


* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across technical, operations, and commercial teams.


* High attention to detail with a strong compliance and audit orientation.


**Benefits:**


* Competitive Salary commensurate with experience.


* Premium health insurance package.


* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.


* Professional development and growth opportunities.

**Reports To:** CEO  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Onsite

**Job Summary**

Passron Enterprises Limited is seeking a highly competent and commercially astute Legal \& Compliance Officer to provide legal oversight across its domestic and international trading operations.

The role is responsible for managing commercial contracts, ensuring regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions, and providing sound legal advisory to support trading transactions, partnerships, and operational activities. The ideal candidate must possess strong experience in commercial law and cross\-border transactions, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, transaction\-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Commercial Contracting \& Advisory:** Draft, review, and negotiate contracts including supply agreements, offtake agreements, vendor contracts, and partnership arrangements, ensuring alignment with business objectives and risk exposure.
* **Regulatory \& Cross\-Border Compliance:** Ensure full compliance with applicable local and international laws governing trade, import/export activities, and commercial operations across relevant jurisdictions.
* **Legal Risk Management:** Identify, assess, and mitigate legal risks across contracts, transactions, and operational activities to safeguard the company’s interests.
* **Regulatory Engagement:** Liaise with regulatory bodies and ensure timely compliance with statutory requirements, licenses, and permits relevant to the company’s operations.
* **Corporate Governance:** Support the development and enforcement of internal policies, procedures, and governance frameworks to ensure compliant and ethical business practices.
* **Dispute Resolution:** Manage legal disputes, claims, and contractual issues, providing practical and commercially sound resolutions.
* **Operational Legal Support:** Provide ongoing legal guidance to internal teams to ensure legal considerations are embedded in business decisions and execution.
* **Documentation \& Records Management:** Maintain accurate and auditable legal records, contracts, and compliance documentation for internal governance and external reviews.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LL.B) with a minimum of Second Class Upper (2:1\); BL qualification is required.
* Minimum of 5–8 years’ relevant experience in commercial or corporate law, preferably within trading, oil \& gas, commodities, or industrial environments.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts.
* Demonstrated experience supporting cross\-border transactions and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
* Sound knowledge of applicable legal and regulatory frameworks within Nigerian and international trading environments.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong commercial and legal judgment
* High attention to detail and risk awareness
* Strong negotiation and advisory capability
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, business\-driven environments
* High level of integrity and professionalism

**Role Expectations**

The successful candidate will be expected to provide practical, business\-focused legal guidance, ensure full compliance across all operations, and proactively protect the company’s interests in both domestic and international trading activities.

Min Qualification: Degree Experience Level: Senior level Experience Length: 5 years Language Requirement: English Working Hours: Full Time \- 9 to 5 Applicant Location: Lagos, Nigeria
### **Job descriptions \& requirements**

**Responsibilities:**  

**Business Development \& Sales:**

* Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities within the oil and gas EPC sector, including upstream, midstream, and downstream projects.
* Actively manage and grow key client accounts, ensuring long\-term relationships with operators, IOCs, NOCs, service companies, and strategic partners.
* Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation and opportunity qualification to contract negotiation and closure.
* Negotiate commercial terms, contracts, and service agreements to achieve favourable outcomes aligned with company objectives.
* Maintain a robust sales pipeline and provide accurate sales forecasts, reports, and performance updates to management.
 **Bid, Tender \& Proposal Management:**

  

* Coordinate and manage bid and tender submissions, ensuring timely delivery and compliance with client requirements.
* Oversee the preparation of high\-quality technical and commercial proposals, working closely with engineering, procurement, and finance teams.
* Review tender documents, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure proposals meet industry, regulatory, and company standards.

 **Procurement \& Operational Oversight:**

* Oversee procurement processes to ensure cost\-effectiveness, supplier reliability, and adherence to quality and safety standards.
* Support vendor evaluation, selection, and performance management in line with project and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with internal teams to align procurement activities with project schedules and business priorities.

 **Strategy \& Market Intelligence:**

* Contribute to the development and execution of the company’s business strategy and growth plans.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments within the oil and gas sector.
* Identify new growth areas, service offerings, and partnership opportunities to enhance the company’s competitive positioning.
 **Reporting \& Collaboration:**

  

* Prepare regular performance reports on sales activities, pipeline status, procurement outcomes, and strategic initiatives.
* Work closely with the COO and senior management to support decision\-making and operational planning.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

 **Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification (MBA or relevant master’s degree) is an added advantage.
* Professional certifications in sales, procurement, project management, or oil and gas operations are a plus.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in business development, technical sales, operations, or procurement within the oil and gas or EPC sector.
* Proven experience managing bids, tenders, and complex commercial negotiations.
* Strong understanding of oil and gas EPC processes, procurement cycles, and contract structures.
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales and business growth targets.
* Experience working with IOCs, NOCs, EPC contractors, and key industry stakeholders is highly desirable.

 **Requirements:**

* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management abilities
* Solid understanding of technical sales and EPC project environments
* Strategic thinking with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency with CRM tools, Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel), and industry\-related software (e.g., AutoCAD, Primavera P6\) is an advantage.

WTS Energy is seeking a Senior Building Engineer to join their team supporting a major LNG train project in Nigeria. ### **Job descriptions \& requirements**

  

**Company Description**


TAG E \& P LIMITED is a leading business supplies and equipment company headquartered in Castlewood House, New Oxford Street, London, United Kingdom. The company is known for its commitment to delivering high\-quality services and innovative solutions. TAG E \& P LIMITED operates in the energy sector, providing specialized services to support efficient operations. Our team is dedicated to excellence, innovation, and fostering growth in the industries we serve.

  


**Role Description**


This Operations Geologist role is responsible for the planning and execution of Client’s drill\-wells in Nigeria. To accomplish this the Operations Geologist must be competent in well planning and surveillance, integrated pressure prediction, and site investigation; understanding key deliverables


such as a top\-hole prognosis, pore\-pressure prediction, and completed well\-design. Key to the successful drilling of a well is close communication with the Business Unit (Geoscience, Reservoir Engineers), Petrophysicist, and Wells Engineers throughout the design and execution phases of the


project, hence the Operations Geologist must be a good communicator, integrator and be highly organized to effectively change tact as conditions dictate. Evaluating multiple scenarios and ensuring close communication between all parties involved whilst managing expectations to ensure a safe, timely and economic completion of the drilling program meeting all geologic and operational


objectives.

  


**Responsibilities**


* Demonstrate safety leadership and uphold Client’s safety culture ensuring No Spills and the Nobody Gets Hurt, both in the office and if required, on the rig site.
* Strong understanding of integrated pore pressure prediction and surveillance
* Strong understanding of site investigation including shallow drilling hazards evaluation (top\-hole prognosis) and riserless drilling geohazards
* Well planning and surveillance (may include but not limited to):
* Coordinate with the Wells organization and the project Petrophysicist in the contract technical evaluation for MWD/LWD, Wireline, and Mud Logging services (Procurement Tendering)
* Evaluate technical services and compile cost estimates for Wellsite Geology, Wellsite Biostratigraphy, Core Handling/Preservation and Analysis, and wellsite data managemen services as needed
* Compile and document Well Objectives, Formation Evaluation plan, operations \& communication protocols, and data/sample distribution into a Geological Program
* Compile well and evaluation plan information in support of Company regulatory groups (Regulatory)
* Participate/lead regular coordination and planning meetings with the Wells and Geoscience Teams
* Facilitate and communicate with Wells Engineers and project geologists to produce a well plan and casing design which will enable complete evaluation of geologic objectives whilst maintaining an economic and cost\-effective solution
* Design and establishment of casing seat and TD selection protocols, coring and formation evaluation programs.
* Supervision, logistical and technical support of Wellsite Geologic personnel (Wellsite Geologists, Service Company personnel) to gather complete, high quality geologic data sets as specified.
* QC and local loading, storage, and archival of all relevant electronic and physical data using systematic file naming and organization.
* Capture lessons learned for future operational improvements
* Assist, if necessary, in wellsite\-based activities, including selection of casing seats, Geosteering (using Azimuthal Ultra Deep Resistivity), wireline logging and formation testing programs.
* Review and analysis of geologic evaluation programs and service company performance on a well by well or monthly/quarterly basis to identify and address areas with room for improvement.
* Compile and distribute final well reports, logs, and supporting documents to all parties in a timely fashion.
* Presenting technical work to Subsurface and Wells teams including but not limited to TD protocol reviews, prespud meetings and after\-action reviews (AAR).

  


  



**Skills and Qualifications**


* BS/MS in Geology from a recognized institution
* Experience as an Operations Geologist
* Offshore (barge, jackup, MODU) drilling experience
* Fluent in both written and spoken English, have good organizational and coordination skills, and be able to work well with others.
* Flexible to work outside 8am\-5pm to provide 24 hours Ops Geo coverage during drilling and logging operations.
* Flexible to work on Saturday, Sunday, and public holiday to provide 24 hours Ops Geo coverage during drilling and logging operations.
* Offshore experience including platform/deviated well drilling with associated technologies (e.g., LWD, WL).
* Must be in good physical condition and shall comply with all project health and safety requirements (including any rig or country\-specific certifications required to work offshore).
* May be required: Have successfully passed a recognized (OPITO) course in Helicopter Underwater Escape Training (HUET), Sea Survival, and H2S within the previous two years. Certifications must be current and not due to expire for the anticipated duration of the project.
* Experience with mud logging; cuttings description; real\-time image logs; and correlating them to determine lithology and well path.
* Experience with basic FE interpretation for identifying rock type, fluid type, borehole conditions, etc.
* Experience utilizing azimuthal ultra\-deep resistivity (AUDR) for geosteering deepwater highly directional/deviated wells
* Experience with managed pressure drilling (MPD) practices
* Experience with production drilling environments and challenges, i.e. depleted sand, swept compartments, wellbore stability, fluid type uncertainty, etc.
* Experience with directional drilling, well planning, depth control measurements; and understanding of BHA's (Bottom Hole Assembly).
* Experience with coring operations.
* Experience of working in integrated asset team environment.
* Experience in applying structural geology concepts and methods to assess compartmentalization/communication.
* Experience of having worked with geologic modelers to incorporate maps and their interpretations into 3D geologic models.

  


Additional Skills


(Would be of advantage).


* 2D, 3D \& Volume Interpretation and Mapping, AVO Analysis \& Time/Depth Conversion, SeismicStratigraphy, High Resolution Seismic Program Design and Oversight, Engineering Geophysics Data Analysis and Integration, Geotechnical Data Integration, Shallow Top Hole Well Planning, Vendor Contracting, Supervision and evaluation.
* Geologic Scenario Development, Physical Properties Analysis, Burial History Modeling, Velocity Based Pressure Prediction Evaluation, Pressure Prediction Integration for Well Planning, While Drilling Evaluation of LWD logs and drilling parameters.
* Well Planning and Casing Design, OIMS and Regulatory compliance, Casing Seat Selection Protocols, Coring and FE Program Design, FE Vendor Contracting and Evaluation, Well Site Supervision, Well Surveillance \& Program Execution, Post\-Drill follow\-up and integrationv.

**Company Description**


QED International Oil and Gas Nigeria Limited is a company with a strong presence in the energy industry, specializing in oil and gas services. Based in Nigeria, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative and efficient solutions to meet the dynamic needs of the oil and gas sector. QED International prides itself on its commitment to operational excellence, safety, and the development of sustainable energy solutions. The company fosters a collaborative and progressive work environment, valuing expertise and a proactive approach to industry challenges.

  


**Location: Lagos and Bonny**

  


**Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Business Development \& Client Management**


* Identify and develop new business opportunities within the manpower outsourcing, recruitment, and staffing sectors.


* Conduct strategic market mapping and develop growth strategies targeting specific industries (oil and gas, engineering, construction, etc.).


* Develop and execute sales strategies that align with company goals, revenue targets and expansion plans.


* Maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients through research, networking, cold calls, industry events and referrals.


* Collaborate with senior management to set business targets and design manpower development programs aligned with market demands.


* Evaluate and recommend partnerships, joint ventures or collaborations that enhance the manpower service offerings.


**2\. Client Relationship Management**


* Serve as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams for all manpower\-related services.


* Build, maintain and strengthen long\-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.


* Schedule and lead client meetings to understand staffing requirements, project timelines and performance expectations.


* Manage client feedback, address service concerns and ensure continuous improvement in delivery standards.


* Facilitate client satisfaction surveys and implement corrective actions where necessary.


**3\. Project \& Operational Coordination**


* Work closely with the Recruitment, HR and Operations teams to ensure timely sourcing, onboarding and deployment of qualified personnel.


* Assist manpower mobilization, demobilization and replacement processes according to project schedules.


* Ensure that all deployed staff meet client specifications in terms of skill, certification and conduct.


* Oversee timesheet management, attendance reporting and contract renewals for outsourced staff.


* Track workforce performance metrics, discipline issues and turnover rates; provide reports and recommendations for improvement.


* Coordinate all pre\-deployment documentation, including background checks, compliance forms and client acceptance.


**4\. Market Research \& Strategy**


* Conduct market intelligence to identify trends, competitors and potential clients in manpower services.


* Support in developing strategies to expand market share and improve brand visibility.


* Provide feedback and reports on market activities and client needs to inform business strategy.


**5\. Proposal \& Documentation Management**


* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, expressions of interest (EOIs), capability statements and tender submissions for manpower projects.


* Collaborate with the proposal team to develop tailored solutions that meet client requirements and budgetary expectations.


* Ensure proper documentation of all business development activities, leads, contracts etc.


* Maintain an updated database of manpower projects, client records and performance reports.

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resource Management, Marketing, or related field.


* Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in business development, preferably in manpower supply, recruitment, or outsourcing.


* Proven track record in client acquisition and relationship management.


* Ability to travel as required.

  


Qualified candidates can send their cv to recruitment@qedi\-ng.com or hr@qedi\-ng.com

### **Job descriptions \& requirements**

  

**About Carogas**


Carogas is building Nigeria's first structured, quality\-controlled barite supply chain for the upstream oil and gas. We are hiring a Field Supervisor to anchor our on\-ground operations across our gathering hub in Plateau State.

  


**The Role**


You will be our primary representative on the ground, receiving barite ore from artisanal miners, running XRF quality tests, managing stockpiles, coordinating truck loading and dispatch, and enforcing Carogas's intake and payment standards. This is a hands\-on field role. You will spend most of your time at hub sites and mine locations.

  


**What You Will Be Doing**


* Receiving and registering barite deliveries from artisanal miners and mine owners
* Operating portable XRF devices to test and grade incoming ore
* Managing stockpile segregation and inventory records at each hub
* Sorting accepted ore by quality tier, overseeing washing where required, and supervising bagging and weighing of material into bags
* Supervising loading of bags onto haulage trucks and ensuring documentation is complete
* Building relationships with miners across the zone
* Enforcing payment controls, conducting daily reconciliations, and submitting field reports
* Maintaining hub security, access control, and HSE standards

  


**What We Are Looking For**


* Degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Mineral Processing, or a related field
* 5–7 years of field experience in solid minerals or mining operations in Nigeria
* Ability to speak Hausa is a strong advantage for effective communication with miners and local communities across the hub zones
* Real, hands\-on experience working with artisanal and small\-scale miners. You must understand how they operate and how to earn their trust
* Practical knowledge of barite or other industrial minerals
* Strong logistics instincts, comfortable coordinating loading, transport, and documentation
* Integrity, operational discipline, and the ability to work independently in the field
* XRF experience is a plus; existing miner relationships in Plateau is a strong advantage

  


**Why Join Carogas**


This is a ground\-floor opportunity to play a central role in building something new in Nigerian solid minerals. You will have real responsibility, direct field ownership, and room to grow as the operation scales toward full beneficiation and export.

  


Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

### **Job descriptions \& requirements**

  

How you can make your mark  

Make your mark as Technical Superintendent Nigeria at Smit Lamnalco  

You will manage and execute running ‘day\-to\-day’ Maintenance and Repair (M\&R) activities of vessels assigned to you within time\-frame and budget as set, in order to maintain technical reliability and maximize utilization of the fleet.  

**Your Responsibilities**

  

* Coordinate and execute ‘day\-to\-day’ running maintenance activities (mainly preventive) onboard the vessels to maintain technical reliability of vessels and prevent downtime/off\-hire.
* Supervise, coach and instruct chief engineers onboard the vessels to ensure technical management onboard is in line with company expectation
* Execute repairs, supervise crew and subcontractors in line with the agreed planning, budget and quality standards.
* Take responsibility for the correct allocation of costs related to the vessel’s repair and maintenance, dockings, damages and modifications.
* Guides crew on board the vessels to ensure Company standard are met and work is done as per guidelines and specifications
* Actively promotes Safety Health Environmental and Quality (SHEQ) awareness and monitors performance to ensure safety standards and safe working practices /leads ‘by example’
* IInterface with Regulatory Authorities \& Stakeholders i.e. Classification Society \& Flag State on technical integrity of vessels whilst maintaining cordial relationship with stakeholders.

  

To fulfil the position of Technical Superintendent Nigiria you are in the possession of:

  

* Experience as technical superintendent or technical manager in a similar environment / company.
* At least higher / secondary vocational education in mechanical engineering, naval architect or equivalent.
* Experience as former chief engineer on offshore support Vessels is preferred.
* At least 7 years verifiable experience gained as technical superintendent/port engineer or technical manager.
* Fluent command of the English language, spoken and written.

  

We offer  

What you can expect

  

* A dynamic environment: A job that allows you to collaborate with a talented team of experts from different backgrounds and contribute to making a significant impact.
* Rewarding conditions: This is a great opportunity for a talented and motivated technical professional who is keen and eager to join an International Marine company. Smit Lamnalco offers a competitive compensation \& benefit package.
* Career development: We offer you plenty of opportunities to bring out the best in yourself .

  

Extra information

  

* Your team: You will be part of the Fleet Management Department of AfrikDelta Marine Ltd, operational unit fully controlled by Smit Lamnalco which consist of approximately 10 professionals. You will report to the Regional Fleet Manager.
* Where you will work: You will work in Onne (Port Harcourt) on a rotation of 8/8 weeks and may be required to travel occasionally.
* Full/part\-time job: The position of technical superintendent is a full\-time job, work hours to be adjusted as per operational requirement.
* Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.

  

**About Boskalis**  

Smit Lamnalco is part of the Boskalis group of companies. Working at Smit Lamnalco is about providing marine support services tailored to the unique operational needs of our global customers in local markets. Our promise to our clients is to provide the best marine services possible, no matter how challenging the environment or how remote the location.  

In Nigeria, Smit Lamnalco provides technical services to AfrikDelta Marine Limited (ADML). ADML is a 100% Nigerian owned marine and offshore services company, established to provide premium, safe, reliable and efficient services to the major oil and gas companies in Nigeria and the Gulf of Guinea.  

ADML was established in July 2012 providing quality service to the Nigeria’s offshore oil and gas production. ADML is a major player in the Nigeria Oil and Gas industry with focus on Midstream and Offshore Terminal Marine operations. The company is managed by an experienced team of marine industry expert and has become the leading indigenous provider of marine services in the region.  

Interested?  

We’ll be happy to answer your questions about the position of technical superintendent Nigeria. Please contact Sandra Hofstede, senior corporate recruiter via 06\-46042957\.  

Please apply via our website before 20th April.  

Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies  

We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.  

Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions.

description:
What’s the role 



Join us as a Graduate at Shell in Nigeria where you will embark on a comprehensive 3-year program designed to develop future leaders.



The Graduate Recruitment within Shell follows a standard global methodology used to attract, select, and place our best talent within the various Shell businesses. For 2026, we are recruiting post-NYSC graduates



What you’ll be doing 



You will showcase your capacity to analyze situations and propose purposeful solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals - adaptability to changing environments, learner mindset, drive to deliver results - and collaborate and nurture relationships as you work effectively with a diverse team. You will work with experienced colleagues and will share your unique perspective and fresh ideas on how to tackle energy-related challenges. Our inclusive and collaborative culture will provide you with the support you need to grow your skills as you work on meaningful projects with exciting responsibilities right from the start. 



What you bring 



We are looking for a candidate who thrives on new challenges and embraces innovation. You should be confident in your ability to absorb information, analyze problems, make objective decisions, and generate original ideas. The ideal candidate will possess the drive and resilience to achieve goals, the flexibility to collaborate effectively within a team, and the credibility to influence others. Being open to alternative perspectives and views is essential, using them to refine ideas and outcomes. 



Eligibility 



To be eligible for the Shell Graduate Program: 




	You must have graduated Bachelor’s or Master’s before your start date
	You must have less than three years of work experience.
	You must have completed the National Youth Service Corps NYSC programme
	You must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.


Please indicate your NYSC Certificate or NYSC Exemption in your CV. 



Submitting more than one application will lead to automatic disqualification of all your applications.

MAIN FUNCTIONS




	Responsible for planning, coordinating and controlling the day-to-day field operations for the assigned crafts and subcontractors. A typical scope of responsibility would be Field Superintendent or Area Superintendent.


TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES



In addition to all Level 1 and 2 tasks, a Level 3 Construction Superintendent will:




	Assist in preparation and review for submittals, RFIs and RFCs and make recommendations regarding suitability
	Review contractor health and safety plans, traffic control and erosion control measures on projects
	Verify quantities for payment
	Identify non-conformance issues with construction work and help develop potential resolution of non-conformance issues
	May serve as the lead Company representative at sub-sites where the Construction Site Manager or Construction Site Lead typically does not reside
	Provide construction core competency expertise when assigned to the function
	Ensure good communications and relations with the contractors


SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS




	Experience in-field Construction planning, execution, and completions
	Willing to travel domestic/overseas to project sites
	Past Construction Superintendent experience on major capital project
	Familiar with Construction Materials Testing procedures and ASTM standards
	Enthusiastic, self-starter with desire to provide excellent service to clients.

Job Summary

The Quality Control (QC) Officer / Laboratory Assistant is responsible for ensuring that all agricultural commodities procured, processed, and packaged by Abans | Agro Processing meet stringent internal quality standards and international export specifications. This role involves a combination of hands-on laboratory analysis, on-site processing floor supervision, and meticulous documentation. The ultimate goal is to guarantee the purity, safety, and grade consistency of the product range to maintain Abans’ reputation as a premier high-grade exporter.

Range of Products Covered

The officer will be responsible for the quality assurance of the following commodities and their various cuts/grades:

Hibiscus Flower (Whole, Sifting, Tea bag Cut, Powder)

Sesame Seeds (Natural/Unhulled)

Dried Ginger (Split)

Cashew Nuts (Raw and Processed grades WW320, SW240, SSW320, WW240)

Moringa Leaves

Cocoa Beans (Fermented)

Processed Herbal Tea Cuts

Maize

Groundnuts/Peanuts (In-shell and kernels)

Soybeans

Key Responsibilities

1. Sampling and Laboratory Analysis

Representative Sampling: Develop and implement strict sampling protocols for incoming raw materials, in-process goods, and finished products awaiting export, ensuring samples are representative of the entire lot.

Physical Testing: Conduct physical analyses on all commodities, including:

 Moisture Content: Utilizing moisture meters or oven-drying methods to ensure levels are within spec (e.g., $\le$ 8% for Hibiscus, $\le$ 6% for Sesame, $\le$ 5% for Cashews).

 Purity/Admixture Determination: Analyzing samples to identify and quantify impurities, foreign matter, and dust (aiming for standards like 99% purity for Hibiscus/Sesame).

 Grading & Sizing: Sorting and grading cashews by nut count (70–200/kg) and outturn ($>48$lbs), and groundnuts by kernel size (38/42, 40/50).

 Color & Visual Inspection: Assessing the deep burgundy red of hibiscus, light yellow of soybeans, and the absence of moldy/damaged nuts/beans.

 Chemical/Organoleptic Testing:

 Oil & FFA Content: Arranging for or conducting tests to determine Free Fatty Acids ($\le$ 2%) and Oil Content (48%–52%) for Sesame, and oil content for Groundnuts/Soybeans.

 Aflatoxin Testing: Specialized testing for Groundnuts to ensure compliance with EU standards ($< 4$ppb).

 Protein Content: Analyzing Soybeans for target protein levels (35–40%).

 Sensory Evaluation: Assessing aroma and flavor for Ginger, Cocoa, and Herbal Teas.

2. Processing Floor Supervision & Hygiene (In-Process QC)

Operational Oversight: Monitor sun-drying, hand-sorting, machine-cleaning, and splitting processes to ensure they do not compromise product quality.

CCP Monitoring: Identify and monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) in the processing line to prevent contamination (physical, chemical, or biological).

Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP): Enforce strict hygiene standards for personnel, equipment, and the processing environment to meet international food safety standards.

Pesticide Control: Verify that commodities (especially Sesame) are pesticide-free before processing.

3. Finished Goods Verification & Packaging

Pre-Shipment Inspection: Conduct final sorting and grading checks before bagging to remove any remaining damaged items.

Packaging Compliance: Verify that correct packaging materials are used (e.g., 40kg PP bags for Sesame/Hibiscus, Jute bags for Cashews/Cocoa) and that bags are properly sealed, unsoiled, and correctly labeled with origin, grade, and non-GMO status.

Container Inspection: Inspect shipping containers prior to loading to ensure they are clean, dry, odor-free, and suitable for food-grade cargo to prevent spoilage during transit.

4. Documentation and Reporting

Batch Records: Maintain detailed, accurate, and up-to-date records of all lab tests, sorting results, and in-process checklists linked to specific batch numbers.

Certificates of Analysis (COA): Prepare internal COAs for every shipment, certifying that the product meets FOB/CIF contract specifications.

Non-Conformance Reports: Document any deviations from quality standards, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions to the Operations Manager.

Inventory Quality Status: Advise the warehouse team on the quality status of stored raw materials to ensure "First-In, First-Out" (FIFO) based on quality factors.

Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Food Science & Technology, Biochemistry, Agricultural Science, or a related laboratory science field.

Experience:

 Minimum of 2–3 years of direct experience in quality control within the agro-processing or food manufacturing sector in Nigeria.

 Proven experience working with export commodities, specifically Hibiscus, Sesame, Ginger, and Cashews, is highly preferred.

 Familiarity with ASTA (American Spice Trade Association) grades and international food safety standards (e.g., ISO 22000, HACCP).

Skills:

 Hands-on capability to operate laboratory equipment (moisture meters, weighing scales, sieves, etc.).

 Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail (visual acuity for sorting/grading is essential).

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, for data entry and trend analysis.

 Excellent communication skills to enforce standards with processing staff and report to management.

• Take responsibility for specific thematic policy and/or safeguard area as assigned by the Director or Associate Director Head.

• Support internal and external capacity building initiatives and mentor and coach staff on environmental, social and green finance matters.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes and procedures, including the streamlining, collection, management, and automation of data.

• Preparation of internal and external reports, on the Bank’s reporting approach, and methodologies.

• Work in line with Bank’s Behavioural Competencies and Corporate Behaviours.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Qualifications

• Degree in environmental and/or social sciences/economics, engineering, or related field or comparable professional experience.

• Proven track-record appraising complex environmental and social risks and impacts of a range of projects and/or sectors.

• Knowledge of international good practice environmental, social and climate standards/guidelines (e.g. European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) Environmental and Social Requirements, International Finance Corporation (IFC) Performance Standards, Equator Principles, Paris Agreement alignment, Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD), Task Force on Nature-Related Financial Disclosures (TNFD), International Sustainability Standards Board (SSB), the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), sector guidelines, etc).

• Excellent knowledge of environmental and social thematic policy and safeguard areas and the risks and impacts of various sectors.

• Effective time management and organisational skills and ability to multi-task and delegate tasks.

About Sun King
Sun King is the world’s leading off-grid solar energy company, combining cutting-edge product design, fintech, and field operations to deliver energy access for the 1.8 billion people who live without an affordable and reliable electric-grid connection.

Sun King has built a new kind of energy utility: distributed, green, customer-centric, and affordable. We bring clean, reliable, decentralized energy directly into people’s lives — from solar kits that provide first-time energy access to multi-kilowatt systems that serve both off-grid users and grid-connected customers powering larger homes, schools, hospitals, farms, offices, and light manufacturing.

Already, 25 million homes and businesses rely on Sun King for electricity supply and the appliances and services it enables: lighting, televisions, fans, refrigeration, and smartphones.

Sun King combines energy generation, energy-efficient appliances, installation, and financing into one seamless offering. Think of it as a distributed utility, designed for wherever energy is needed and designed to scale with its users as incomes and energy needs grow.

Sun King makes solar products affordable to low-income households and businesses via ‘pay-as-you-go’ (PAYG) purchase financing. Sun King installs solar after customers pay a small deposit. Customers then make small, manageable payments of as little as US $0.14 a day via mobile money or cash.

Instead of paying for expensive, polluting, and health-damaging kerosene for lighting or diesel for power, customers unlock savings through accessing solar power and after one to two years of payments, customers own their solar equipment outright.

Sun King collects payments digitally through mobile money systems and its 35,000 field agents — over 1 million payments each day. To date, Sun King has extended more than $1.4 billion in PAYG loans to customers.

Sun King began by powering homes and businesses with solar systems delivered through PAYG financing. Now, we’re using the same model to make smartphones and clean cooking equipment affordable: helping households connect to the digital economy and transition from wood-based fuels to modern, sustainable alternatives.

Sun King employs 3,500 full-time staff in 14 countries, with specialties spanning product design, data science, logistics, customer service, sales, software, operations, and more — all with a passion to serve off-grid families. Sun King is committed to gender diversity in the workplace. Women represent 42% of Sun King’s workforce.

We are looking for a Fraud Manager - West Africa to join our Fraud team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

Role Overview

As Fraud Manager, you'll own the full cycle of consumer fraud risk management from establishing prevention systems and processes, to leading analytical detection and diagnosis of fraud events, to directing investigations and criminal proceedings, to implementing mitigation measures. You'll develop country-wide fraud policies and processes, manage KPIs, lead a team of investigators and analysts, build detection solutions, and collaborate with Legal, Internal Audit, and Product teams. You'll create a culture of fraud awareness across M-KOPA while managing a large portfolio of investigation and assurance engagements. This role directly protects how 7 million customers experience financial trust.

About M-KOPA

M-KOPA is a financial technology company protecting financial access for 7 million customers across Africa. We've unlocked $2+ billion in credit for people who'd never accessed formal financial services. We've contributed $45 million in taxes to African economies, assembled 2 million smartphones in Kenya, and financed 4,000+ e-motorbikes; saving riders an average of $5.62 daily.

We're deliberately scaling our fraud management infrastructure globally. We need leaders who understand that managing fraud risk here means protecting something different: 7 million customers accessing financial services for the first time, building trust in a system designed for their economic empowerment.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Global Fraud Manager.

What You'll Do

Develop and maintain fraud prevention and management policies and processes. Lead end-to-end standardization of fraud risk identification and detection processes.

Assess fraud risk scenarios and design detection solutions integrating technologies and management expertise.

Lead and manage a team of field investigators and data analysts in prevention, detection, investigation, and mitigation of fraudulent activities.

Manage KPIs and drive accountability for cost-effective achievement of team objectives. Initiate new prevention and monitoring methods to improve the company's ability to foresee systemic risks.

Ensure data-driven decisions and professional standards of quality. Support Legal and Internal Audit in building criminal investigations, disciplinary processes, and systems that identify risks and trends.

Create fraud awareness culture through formal employee training. Coordinate insurance claims with Finance. Identify control gaps and recommend enhancements.

What You Bring

Minimum 5+ years of demonstrable experience in fraud risk prevention and detection—through fraud management, fraud analytics, internal audit, forensic investigations, or criminal justice in banking, payment, capital markets, insurance, FinTech, or energy sectors.

Bachelor's Degree in Criminology or related field.

Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) credential or comparable fraud-related certification.

Advanced analytical capability - proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint, and PowerBI or data visualization systems. Strong comfort with data, analytical thinking, causal diagnosis, and trend interpretation.

Team and project leadership - ability to manage field-based operational teams and desk-based analytical resources. Strong background in cost-effective decision-making including ROI analysis and KPI monitoring.

Strategic fraud expertise - understanding of criminal justice systems, identification of fraud indicators through data mining, and ability to manage stakeholder engagement across diverse audiences.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025) and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 6 million customers, unlocking $1.5 billion in cumulative credit for the unbanked across Africa.

SENIOR ACCOUNTANT JOB DESCRIPTION

Our client is a recognised player in the upstream oil and gas sector, committed to delivering high-performance solutions that support efficient and safe field operations. With a strong focus on innovation and service excellence, the company specializes in the production and supply of high-quality chemicals, as well as comprehensive maintenance services for oil fields. They work closely with industry stakeholders to enhance operational productivity, extend asset life cycles, and ensure optimal performance across exploration and production activities.

Senior Accountant reporting to Finance Manager / CFO Lagos, Nigeria Full-time, Permanent and sector is Upstream Oil & Gas — Chemicals & Field Maintenance Experience Required 7 – 9 Years (incl. consulting background)

The Senior Accountant will play a pivotal role in strengthening internal controls, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, and bringing a consultative lens to financial analysis and cost management.

The client is specifically seeking someone with a consulting or advisory background, an individual who has worked beyond the transactional accounting function and is comfortable translating financial data into actionable insights for business leaders. This hire represents an investment in the quality and maturity of the company's financial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Reporting & Compliance

● Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in line with IFRS and company policies.

● Ensure full compliance with Nigerian tax obligations including PAYE, VAT, WHT, CIT, and FIRS filings.

● Coordinate with external auditors and manage the statutory audit process end-to-end.

● Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts, and supporting documentation. Management Accounting & Advisory

● Prepare detailed management accounts, cost analyses, and financial performance reports for senior leadership.

● Conduct variance analysis, identifying root causes of budget deviations and recommending corrective action.

● Apply a consultative approach to financial analysis, framing insights in the context of operational and commercial implications.

● Support pricing decisions, project cost reviews, and contract evaluations from a financial perspective. Budgeting & Forecasting

● Lead the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecast processes, working cross-functionally with operations, procurement, and commercial teams.

● Track financial performance against budget and provide regular updates and recommendations to leadership.

● Develop scenario models and financial projections to support strategic planning. Internal Controls & Process Improvement

● Review, document, and strengthen internal financial controls and accounting procedures. ● Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements that reduce financial risk and improve accuracy.

● Ensure the appropriate use and integrity of the company's accounting software and ERP systems. Treasury & Working Capital

● Monitor cash flow, manage bank reconciliations, and ensure effective working capital management.

● Oversee accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely processing and reconciliation. ● Liaise with banks and financial institutions as required.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

● Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

● Professional certification required: ACA (ICAN), ACCA, or equivalent. Candidates who are in the final stage of qualification will be considered.

● 5 to 8 years of progressive accounting experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a consulting, advisory, or professional services environment.

● Prior experience in the oil and gas sector or energy-related industries is a strong advantage.

● Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Sage, QuickBooks, SAP, or similar ERP platforms). ● Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with data visualisation or financial modelling tools is a plus.

● Strong working knowledge of IFRS, Nigerian tax regulations, and relevant statutory requirements.

● Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality financial reports, management accounts, and board-ready presentations.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a financially astute, analytically rigorous, and commercially aware accountant who brings more than technical competence to this role. You have spent meaningful time in a consulting or advisory environment, whether in a Big Four or mid-tier audit/advisory firm, a management consulting firm, or an in-house function that operated in a consultative capacity, and you understand how to translate numbers into decisions.

You are not a passive order-taker. You are a thought partner, someone who walks into a business and quickly diagnoses what the financials are telling them, identifies what is missing, and knows how to communicate that clearly to people who are not accountants. You are disciplined in execution but flexible in thinking, and you bring energy and standards to every output you produce. Your background in the oil and gas sector, whether upstream, midstream, or oilfield services, will be an advantage, but what matters most is your ability to operate in a technically complex, fast-moving environment where precision, adaptability, and good judgment are non-negotiable.

TRANSFORMATION OBJECTIVES

In the first 12 months, the successful candidate will be expected to:

● Establish a more disciplined month-end close process and ensure full compliance with IFRS and relevant Nigerian tax regulations.

● Lead a structured review of existing financial controls and identify gaps or inefficiencies in the company's accounting systems and processes.

● Develop cost analysis frameworks that give operational leadership better visibility into project profitability and overhead management.

● Bring consulting-quality thinking to budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, producing outputs that drive commercial decisions, not just satisfy compliance requirements.

● Support the finance leadership team in building a finance function that can scale with the business over the next three to five years.

Job Description:

Where you fit in?

As a IT Controls Systems Engineer you will deliver or improve the range of activities necessary to seamlessly integrate and operate one of the world’s largest IT estates. The scope covers service management activities, Hybrid on-premise and Cloud operational landscapes with many integration points; and the integration of the interdependent services of diverse internal and external service providers into end-to-end services which deliver value to Shell.

What is the Role?

This Role will report to the IT Operations Manager working in conjuction with other operations technology security stakeholders to provide services as listed below:

• Ensure the Safe, Secure, and Steady and Reliable production operations on Onshore/Offshore Fields Asset in Nigeria via sustained Process Control Domain (PCD) IT Controls effectiveness and preventing impact to asset integrity.
• Ensure 1st Line Support and request management, SecurePlant and L2/L3 Firewall device management, Central Anti-Virus server & Patch deployment management.
• Co-ordinate Logistics and Scheduling and Maintenance Planning for Control Systems IT Support personnel.
• Supervise and Co-ordinate Core CS-IT activities for SNEPCO PCD activities including: Backup & Disaster recovery, remote access requests and management, end-point protection for hosts, implementation of configuration changes for hosts and network, inventory management
• Carry out deviation management and risk assessment for all facilities within the Nigeria PCD space.
• PCD assurance and assessments – physical security, backup and disaster recovery, remote access, Antivirus and Operating system patches.
• Liaising with Technical Authority for production operations towards ensuring compliance of IT Security within the PCD.
• Drive and Ensure the implementation of Incident Response and Management strategies
• Embed Think Secure practices and raise PCD IT Security awareness of staff working in or interacting with the PCD.

• Ensure the team complies with business controls (e.g. Management of Change, Permit to Work) for applying changes in the PCD IT landscape.
• Ensure that Supportability & Transition is effective for IT- or business-led projects that deliver into the PCD IT landscape.
• Monitor the quality of IT infrastructure services supporting PCD (e.g. WAN, Routers, SecurePlant) and ensure changes to those services do not impact operations without prior notification and approval.
• Advise stakeholders on matters concerning PCD IT Security. Keep proper communication to site staff on imminent threats and on cyber security advisories, highlighting the recommended actions for the teams on-site.
• Manage user access to supported systems (e.g. SecurePlant, Sharepoint Site).
• Coordinate firewall rule reviews with the team members to ensure it is aligned with business requirements and have been risk-assessed appropriately.
• Coordinate, along with the team members, the assurance activities of PCD IT Security controls implemented on-site – supporting both 1st Line of Defence (LoD-1) and 2nd Line of Defence (LoD-2) processes

What we need from you?

• With minimum 3-5 years’ experience in IT business analysis, IT security, IT service delivery and IT infrastructure support. The last three years must be managing operations technology security; Experience in an Oil and Gas industry is preferred.
• Minimum Education or Certification: University degree in Electrical, Electronics, Communications Engineering or Applied Sciences (if further degree in Electronics or Communications Engineering),
• Multiple years of experience in support/administration of IT infrastructure services. Completed Training or Certifications in cybersecurity industry certification such as GICSP or ISC2 CISSP is preferred,
• Certifications in networking, Systems administration and IT service Management such as CCNP (enterprise or security), MCSA, SC100, ITILV4 are other Preferred requirements
• Relevant exposure to Process Automation and Controls Optimization disciplines.
• Good knowledge of Control Systems, IT networks, and IT security
• A strong understanding of IT security standards (DEPs, NIST 800-82, OneITCF)
• Significant understanding of the Upstream business and Joint Venture concept
• Experience with IT and Business Risk Management
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills, suitable for diverse cultures and levels in Production and IT
• Ability to manage relations with peers and senior managers effectively in various organizations

Job Summary

IPA Nigeria is seeking an Associate Research & Policy Manager to collaborate closely with a broad range of partners to strengthen their capacity to use evidence to improve programs and policies. The role will involve supporting Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) capacity strengthening and working with sector stakeholders to build sustained buy-in for a culture of evidence generation and use. The Associate Research & Policy Manager will engage across institutions to design and implement analytical approaches that inform decision-making and enhance the use of data in policy and program development. This position requires strong data science and analytical expertise, including the ability to manage and analyse large and complex datasets, design analytical frameworks, and develop visual and reporting systems that translate raw data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences. The successful candidate will combine technical analytical skills with policy acumen and experience supporting partners to apply evidence in real-world decision-making contexts.

Responsibilities

Workplan Management and Reporting

 Collaborate with the partner’s team to develop a shared work plan, ensuring alignment with project goals and effective implementation.  Support with other project management tasks, including progress tracking, financial oversight, and internal and donor reporting. 


Stakeholder Management

 Cultivate relationships with key local top-level decision-makers and ensure the project has their sustained buy-in and input.  Coordinate project activities alongside technical staff from the partner in a learning-by-doing approach, fostering active engagement throughout the process.  Promote engagement to raise awareness of the lab and encourage collaborative efforts for collective impact. 


Generating Relevant Evidence

 Lead the co-creation of a policy-driven research agenda for the regulatory partners, and guide the development of analytically rigorous research projects that generate actionable, data-driven insights.  Facilitate engagement with local and international academics and technical experts to strengthen our partners’ policy-driven research agendas, including advancing robust analytical methods and data use.  Identify and develop opportunities to leverage administrative and other large-scale datasets for policy-relevant research, including structuring data access, preparing datasets for analysis, and connecting local and international researchers to pursue these opportunities.  Manage research projects end-to-end: define research objectives and analytical frameworks, develop protocols, oversee data collection and management systems, supervise statistical analysis, and ensure data quality, reproducibility, and methodological rigor at all stages.  Provide hands-on technical leadership in collecting, cleaning, structuring, integrating, and analysing large and complex administrative or survey datasets, applying reproducible workflows and best practices in data management.  Design and deliver hands-on workshops to build partners’ capacity in data engineering and analytics, including data pipelines, data merging and wrangling, statistical analysis, and dashboard or visual tool development, using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Stata, R, or Python.  Develop and implement analytical and data-visualisation systems (dashboards) that translate raw data into clear, actionable insights for decision-makers, including automated reporting and interactive dashboards where appropriate.  Establish and institutionalise standard operating procedures, documentation, and reproducible analytical workflows so partner staff can independently maintain, update, and scale data systems over time. 


Sharing Evidence to Inform Program Design and Delivery

 Share existing evidence to inform partner’s program design and delivery.  Develop user-friendly data dashboards, visualizations, or summaries for top-level decision-makers, ensuring that complex results are accessible and directly inform program design.  Produce policy briefs on key policy questions.  Work together with the partner, the project team, sector team, global policy and communications teams to lead and/or participate in strategic events for policy purposes, including but not limited to summits, conferences, workshops, technical working groups, and round tables.  In collaboration with researchers and in support of the country director, represent IPA locally in policy conversations and at events. 


Exploring Program Institutionalization

 Engage with the partner’s leadership to explore opportunities to institutionalize the lab for sustainability. 


Qualifications

 Master’s degree in international public policy, economics, statistics, data science, social sciences, or a related field, with 5–7 years of relevant professional experience. Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered.  Strong proficiency in statistical and analytical software (e.g., Stata, R, or Python) for data cleaning, management, analysis, and visualisation.  Demonstrated experience designing and building dashboards and data visualisation tools using platforms such as Power BI or Tableau, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.  Experience working with large and complex administrative datasets, including data integration, structuring, and analysis, and experience building or supporting automated data pipelines or reporting systems.  Hands-on experience designing, strengthening, or implementing Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) systems, including data collection, management, and analysis frameworks.  Proven ability to manage multiple research or analytical projects simultaneously, including planning timelines, coordinating stakeholders, and managing deliverables and budgets, preferably in a development or public policy context.  Strong grounding in quantitative and qualitative research methods, including experience applying rigorous analytical approaches to inform policy or program decisions.  Demonstrated ability to train, coach, or mentor others in data analysis, statistics, or MEL systems, including building institutional capacity for data use.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical analysis into clear, structured, and policy-relevant insights for non-technical audiences.  Experience working with government institutions or regulatory agencies is highly desirable.  Superior analytical, quantitative, and conceptual thinking skills.  Willingness to be a team player and identify connections between work streams.  Cultural and political sensitivity and demonstrated ability to work successfully with diverse constituencies.  Passion for making data-driven decision-making a reality in the development sector.

About IPA

Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA) is a research and policy nonprofit that discovers and advances what works to improve the lives of people living in poverty. IPA brings together researchers and decision-makers to design, rigorously evaluate, and refine these solutions and their applications, ensuring that the evidence created is used to improve the lives of people living in poverty. In recent decades, trillions of dollars have been spent on programs designed to reduce global poverty, but clear evidence of which programs succeed is rare, and when evidence does exist, decision-makers often do not know about it. IPA exists to bring together leading researchers and these decision-makers to ensure that the evidence we create leads to a tangible impact on the world. Since its founding in 2002, IPA has worked with over 600 leading academics to conduct over 1,000 evaluations in 52 countries. This research has informed hundreds of successful programs that now impact millions of individuals worldwide.

 Safeguarding at IPA 

At Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA), we are committed to creating a safe and respectful environment for all individuals, particularly children and vulnerable adults. As IPA adheres to strict safeguarding principles, selected candidates will be expected to adhere to the standards. By joining IPA, you become part of a team dedicated to ethical conduct, social responsibility, and meaningful impact in the fight against global poverty. Together, we work to create a better world where everyone has the opportunity to thrive with dignity and respect.

Required Qualification

Nice to Have

The role is responsible for supporting infrastructure and construction projects through professional drone operations, geospatial data collection, remote sensing, and GIS-based analysis.  Drone Operations & Mission PlanningOperate RTK-enabled drones to conduct surveying, mapping, inspection, and construction monitoring activities. Remote Sensing & Technical SupportUtilize remote sensing techniques to evaluate terrain characteristics and environmental conditions. Drone Pilot Remote Sensing Technician Assistant Drone Pilot & Surveyor GIS Analyst

Regular travel to project locations across the country. Field-based work within active construction environments. Combination of on-site drone operations and office-based GIS data processing.
